text:
jon: Quick sync from the token-validation postmortem (INC-2071). Consolidated action items below. Please ack and call out blockers. TL;DR: expired third-party signing key + missing permission canary + partial audit schema gaps (user_id missing for 2 endpoints).

tara: I'll own the permission-smoke-tests + canary gate. Plan: write 3 pytest cases that run as pre-deploy check and a small Datadog metric for post-deploy. Target date: 2026-03-31. Creating tracker card now.

ken: taking the key rotation automation + KMS policy change. I need a security sign-off on the IAM tweak (iam:Decrypt -> service-rotation-sa). ETA: docs + dry-run by 2026-03-26. Will post a dry-run log to the board.

ops: On-prem rollout window request: 2026-04-06 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll need customer notifications for managed installs; air-gapped customers require a manual schedule.

security-bot: Action owners must acknowledge within 24h or escalate. Tracker: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2071/actions. Reminder scheduled in 48h.

tara: Proposed Datadog canary (feel free to tweak):

```
logs("service:auth AND endpoint:token* AND !user_id").index("*").rollup("count").last("10m") > 5
```

infra-bot: Auto-created board card: https://redwood/boards/INC-2071-owners. Card fields: owner, eta, status, linked PRs.

jon: audit logging owner? we still need someone to push the schema change (emit user_id + request_id) and a migration/compat plan. Without user_id we can't correlate authz failures.

ben: (joined thread) I can take audit schema. Est 2 sprints; can compress to 1 sprint if we freeze docs & noncritical UI prs. Will open draft PR: redwood/auth#998.

ken: note on rollback: rotation will be staged. Both keys active for 36h (config change from previous 48h after discussion). Rotation script has --staged flag. Command example: `./scripts/rotate-keys --staged --verify`.

tara: added a short playbook snippet to the runbook for the canary firing: escalate to #eng-oncall, page oncall if it persists 10m, run `scripts/rotate-keys --rollback` if rotation failed.

ops: Will publish maintenance notice to customers on 2026-03-27. Confirmed on-prem ops team will be staffed for the window.

jon: Checklist (copied to tracker): - [ ] KMS rotation job + CI dry-run (ken) - [ ] IAM policy update + approval (ken + security) - [ ] Audit events patch to include user_id/request_id (ben) - [ ] Permission smoke tests + canary (tara) - [ ] Playbook + runbook updates (tara + ken) - [ ] Customer notice for on-prem (ops)

tara: ack.

ken: ack. Posted PR link in card when ready.

ben: ack. Draft PR will link tests and a migration note.

jon: Great. Next quick check-in Wed 09:30 to surface blockers. If you make progress before then, drop short status updates here. Leaving thread open. :spiral_calendar_pad:
